name: vllm-cuda-spark-wheel
description: vLLM wheel built from source on the vllm-openai aarch64 base for NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, sm_121), packaged as a FROM-scratch image (the .whl + commit.txt only). Compiled with the CUDA-13.0 toolkit so the emitted PTX is 9.0 (JIT-able by the 580 host driver) and TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.1 yields native sm_121 SASS -- this is the toolkit pin that fixes cudaErrorUnsupportedPtxVersion on Marlin/AWQ + flash-attn. Compiled incrementally via a persistent ccache BuildKit cache mount. Consumed by the vllm-cuda-spark assembler to produce clean nightly/release images in ~2 min without recompiling. ABI-locked to (VLLM_TAG, VLLM_BASE, sm_121, py3.12, CUDA 13.0); rebuild only when bumping vLLM or the base image.
